f_bust.notes: Qwen v3 (AIGC: full hat with cream badge on band, soft silk tassel at hat right, no ribbon).

f_profile.notes: Strict left-facing profile, head bowed; no eye or brow, only the forehead-nose-lips-chin contour. Rosette with rectangular rays and a black centre. Floats.

f_reach.notes: Qwen v3, reaching hand at viewer's left (white palm), soft silk tassel at hat left, full hat.

f_eye.notes: Face close-up, one eye open (orange iris), looking straight at the viewer. A crop, not a bust: only full-bleed or clipped by a shape. ALWAYS drawn mirrored (flip: true); mirrored, the eye is at x = 1254 - 730 = 524. First seen on the DISHEARTENED beat (124.89 s), nowhere before.

boy_bust.notes: Boy, front bust, faceless. Registers with f_bust at scale 0.89, offset (+60, -18) source px (art.fit). Pre-chorus 2 only.

man_bust.notes: Adult man, front bust, faceless. Registers with f_bust at scale 0.873, offset (+81, -4). Only ever a faint ghost.

cat_bust.notes: f_bust redrawn with two striped cat ears. Registers with f_bust at scale 1.00, offset (-28, -49): the two nearly coincide.

cat_paws.notes: Cat-eared, both fists raised like paws, eyes half closed, striped tail at viewer's left. The right ear tip touches the top of the canvas: leave headroom above it.

qwen_bust.notes: Qwen v4 (user final bust: grey-violet hair, Qwen mark + tassel ornament, white jacket; processed by tools/qwen_bust2.py from the user image)

qwen_profile.notes: Qwen girl in a left-facing bowed profile (generated from qwen_bust with ImageGen, cut to the film 3 inks by tools/qwen_profile.py). Same design as qwen_bust: bob hair, three-blade mark + tassel, cream jacket with a bow.

qwen_eye.notes: Qwen girl face close-up, one eye, generated from qwen_bust with ImageGen; processed to the 3 inks by tools/qwen_eye.py. Iris at (412,664) in asset px.
